name: OpenCV ring inspector
description: Offline OpenCV nail review: ring ablation, sector grain measurements with evidence marking, A/center/B motion, guarded registration, held-out wood null tests and frozen smoothing comparisons with known-motion and wrong-correspondence controls.
setup: Create a Python virtual environment and install this tool's requirements.txt.
side_effects: Reads explicitly supplied local images and manifest, creates a new local HTML/JS/JSON/PNG report directory. Optional review marks write browser local storage and user-exported JSON. No source modifications, training, network calls, uploads, production decisions, or device settings changes. Reports contain customer images and identifiers; keep them private.
